sections.title: Sound of the letter
paragraphs: The letter is named (дэ) /dɛ/. Its main sound is heard in (дом) /dom/, which means house. This letter makes four sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Press the tip of your tongue against the back of your upper teeth. Stop the air for a moment, let your voice hum, then release the air. For the soft sound, also raise the middle of your tongue. For the other two sounds, turn off your voice. Touch your throat to feel when your voice turns on and off.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: Before hard vowels and voiced consonants, it makes its main sound, as in (дом) /dom/. Before soft vowels or the soft sign, it becomes palatalized, as in (день) /dʲenʲ/. Palatalized means you raise the middle of your tongue toward the roof of your mouth. At the end of a word or before voiceless consonants, it sounds like (сад) /sat/. If softened before those positions, it sounds like (медь) /mʲetʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not place your tongue on the ridge behind your upper teeth as in day. Put your tongue directly on the back of your teeth instead. At the end of a word, do not keep your voice on. Turn your voice completely off so that the ending sounds like the t in bat.
